newsitem.title: USA: Hibernia Foods sees revs up on merger.
newsitem.headline: Hibernia Foods sees revs up on merger.

text.p: Dublin-based Hibernia Foods Plc said on Wednesday that it expected annual revenues on a pro forma basis to exceed $84 million with the addition of Majestic Food Group Ltd, an independent frozen dessert manufacturer based in the United Kingdom.
The $84 million figure represents nearly a tripling of the company's current annual revenues.

Hibernia acquired Majestic in a stock and cash transaction valued at roughly $2.3 million. In addition, Hibernia, a beef producer, said it was making an immediate working capital investment of about $4.4 million.
As a result of the acquisition, there are now about 6.6 million ordinary shares outstanding in Hibernia, the company said in a statement.
Majestic's two principal shareholders, Derek Hollins and Derek Cooper, have joined the Hibernia management team, Hibernia added.
